Subject: GCP invoice — duplicate metering lines & VAT allocation

Hi Neha,

We received the December GCP Marketplace invoice yesterday (attached) and our AP team flagged two issues: 1) there appear to be duplicated metering lines for the sku 'redwood-inference.token-hour' that double-count usage for three projects, and 2) the VAT on the invoice is split between UK VAT and EU VAT in a way that doesn't match our entity mapping — the full bill should be subject to Irish VAT for Belmonte-EU (we provided tax form in onboarding).

I've attached the invoice and our exported metering file (CSV). Can you confirm whether this is a billing export duplication on your side or a reporting anomaly from Google? We need to resolve before we release the payment hold — AP has put the payment on stop until we get confirmation.

Happy to hop on a short call if needed.

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Head of Finance
Belmonte Analytics

Quick plan: I've looped in Karthik (billing/ingest) and Jonas (marketplace ops). If it's our ingest, we will send a corrected invoice and work with Marketplace to retract the duplicate lines.

On the VAT: Belmonte's EU entity is on file, but sometimes the marketplace splits tax by project if project-level tax metadata was inconsistent. Jonas — can you check the invoice allocation rules for Belmonte-EU and whether the tax form we have on record is attached to the correct project IDs? If not, we should open a Marketplace case to reallocate VAT and request a corrected invoice.

Hi all — dug into the CSV and our ingest logs for Dec 30-31. Observations: 
- There are two ingestion events referencing the same GCP usage export for Belmonte that were processed ~2 minutes apart due to a retry loop triggered by a transient 500 from our parsing service. The retry did not dedupe a few batched rows because the batch id header was missing in the second payload. That produced duplicate lines for the token-hour SKU across the three projects you listed.
- I've attached a small sample (neha_requested_logs_20260119.zip) showing the duplicated batch_id missing in the second payload.

Remediation steps I propose: 
1) We prepare an adjustment invoice removing the duplicated lines (I can generate an adjusted ledger and a corrected PDF).
2) Jonas — please open a Marketplace case to retract the original invoice and upload the corrected invoice once ready; request expedited processing given AP hold.
3) We'll provide evidence bundle for Belmonte AP (original CSV, corrected CSV, ingest log snippet).

Marta — if AP needs a short confirmation email from Redwood summarizing the root cause and corrective action, I can draft one and include the log excerpts.

Karthik
Billing Engineer, Redwood Inference
